Name: SunsetJen's Magical Girl Dresses
Author: SunsetJen
Description:
[color=#d4d4d8]Adds the 5 main character outfits from Madoka Magica to Stardew Valley. [/color]

[size=4][b]How to install:[/b][/size]
[list]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]Install SMAPI 4.0.0 or later and Fashion Sense.[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]Download this mod and extract the ZIP folder into your Stardew Valley Mods folder.[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]Launch the game through SMAPI.[/color][/*]
[/list]
[size=4][b]Requirements:[/b][/size]
[color=#D4D4D8]SMAPI 4.0.0 (or later) and Fashion Sense[/color]

[size=4][b]Shout outs:[/b][/size]
[size=3][color=#D4D4D8]Thank you to every clothing mod and specifically the Youtuber SimBits, who said a yellow dress in a video is supposed to be a magical girl. That's when I realised there are basically no clothing mods for magical girl dresses.[/color][/size]
